line: Owned the weekly carrier scorecards for the regional managers and the monthly review meeting that discussed them.

line: Raised the pickup-slot fill rate by 20% across two dining halls, from 75% to 95%, by setting up a volunteer shift system.

line: After interviewing 25 merchants, mapping chargeback reasons, sizing the loss by segment and drafting a business case with finance, set the next quarter's roadmap priority.

line: Led the rollout of a route-planning tool to 3 depots while rewriting the standard operating procedures, running driver training and taking over vendor negotiations for the telematics contract, which saved 1,800 driver hours a year across the region.
defect: An overlong bullet packing several unrelated activities into one line.

line: Ran the checkout A/B test with randomization by session and reported the 5-point conversion lift as the effect on merchants' customers.
defect: Randomizing by session lets returning customers see both variants, so sessions are not independent and the lift cannot be read as a per-customer effect.

line: Prioritized the dispute roadmap with RICE, scoring Reach as the number of support tickets each feature would close.
defect: In RICE, Reach is how many users a feature affects in a period; tickets closed is an impact measure, so the score double-counts or misplaces it.
